notes.subject: laif
notes.rationale: נפש i klosu long 'wind bilong bel / laif', i no 'soul' olsem Inglis i tok.

notes.subject: ⟨…⟩ man i askim
notes.rationale: Hebru no gat verb insait long askim; Tok Pisin i no gat sampela tok moa.

notes.subject: ואת
notes.rationale: Dispela ואת em i pronoun 'na yu' (H859), i no aleph-tav DOM (H853) — no ⟨את⟩ mak.

notes.subject: askim
notes.rationale: Askim 'bilong hamas taim?' i pulim man i rit long insait long pen bilong David.

translation: Na laif bilong mi i guria tumas tru; tasol yu, Yahwe — bilong hamas taim?
